description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: STARTUP AUTOBAHN powered by Plug and Play – Speed up Innovation! Hey Tech Enthusiasts! Make innovation real with STARTUP AUTOBAHN. We are the open innovation platform that connects startups with industry-leading corporate partners to pilot their technology and drive the ultimate goal: a successful production-ready implementation. STARTUP AUTOBAHN’s flagship event returns to Stuttgart on July 2, 2026. On our platform, startups gain access to industry-leading corporates and are connected directly to the relevant contacts and key decision makers. There is no being redirected or lost between hierarchies and failed leads. STARTUP AUTOBAHN is the interface that enables young companies to collaborate with the key industry players with the aim of bringing innovation to life. We have moved beyond acceleration. STARTUP AUTOBAHN is all about evaluating and driving technology in a real-world environment. Together with our established partners, we have set a clear goal – developing successful production-ready implementations or long-term investments with startups. No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
